summary: The numbers added since the last audit are sound with one exception. C5 (control x moderator, b3 = -1.545, dual-implementation), C6 (CHN/SAU drop, -1.955, independently reproduced), the C1 MDE (1.33 pp/SD, correctly derived) and the Klapper/Galilea citation fixes all trace to source. The one MAJOR item (D1) is a persistence gap, not a wrong value: the C8 within-R2 for the expanded model ('0.0491') is not written to any result file -- the C5 scripts emit only the coefficient. Regenerate with within_r2 persisted, or soften the claim. Four MINOR items: one uncertain citation title (Alok et al.), one incomplete citation (Cornelli et al.), a DOI to confirm, and a redundant status-note enumeration. No result or claim-contract verdict is affected. No manuscript number was altered by this audit.
gate_recommendation: Fix D1 (persist or soften the within-R2), then proceed to the second peer-reviewer-simulation-q1 pass. D2-D5 can be cleared in the same revision or at the citation-verification step; none blocks the referee pass.
